hydrodownloadR

hydrodownloadR provides a unified, extensible interface for discovering hydrological stations and downloading daily time series (water discharge, water level, water temperature, flow velocity) from national/regional public APIs. The package uses a provider registry with identifiers (provider_id, provider_name) and S3 generics stations() / timeseries(). It supports complete histories (1900-01-01 → today), per-station selection, rate limiting & retries, optional auth via environment variables, UTF-8→ASCII normalization, and coordinate transformation to WGS84.

Built for reproducible workflows and easy addition of new providers.

Installation

Development version (GitHub)

```r # Option A: remotes install.packages(“remotes”) remotes::install_github(“bafg-bund/hydrodownloadR”)

Option B: pak (fast)

install.packages(“pak”) pak::pak(“bafg-bund/hydrodownloadR”)
